office.name: Secretary Office
office.reception_role: Everyone here looks after their own part of the server. Just ask.
agent.running: The messenger is in — the agent on the server (v{version}). He picks up the requests and brings back the answers.
agent.away: The messenger is away — the agent on the server isn't running.
agent.away_title: The messenger (the agent on the server) isn't running.
agent.away_text: You see the last known state; nothing can be changed until it is back.
protect.offsite_text: local snapshot + Kopia, encrypted off the server
protect.local_text: only a snapshot or dump on this server — gone with the server
errors.bad_request: The request could not be read.
errors.agent_away: The agent did not pick up the request — is it running?
errors.agent_busy: The agent is still working on it. Try again in a moment.
errors.host_launch_failed: The job could not be handed to the server's at service: {detail}
errors.pin_wait: Too many wrong tries. Wait {seconds} s.
errors.auth_storage: The office can't store the PIN — the folder data/office is missing or not writable. Is the agent running?
auth.locked: Locked — reading only. Click to unlock.
auth.unlock_text: This office is protected. Enter the PIN to change things; this browser stays unlocked for 12 hours.
auth.settings_text_off: Anyone in your LAN can change things at the moment. With a PIN, the office stays readable for everyone, but deleting, starting a backup and the like need the PIN.
auth.settings_text_on: Changing things needs the PIN. Change it here, or remove it to let everyone in your LAN change things again.
auth.not_writable: The folder data/office is missing or not writable — the agent creates it when it starts.
auth.new: New PIN (4 to 64 characters, digits or letters)
auth.forgot: Forgot it? Delete data/office/auth.json on the server.
auth.mismatch: The two new PINs don't match.
auth.saved: PIN saved — other browsers are locked now
help.title: How the office works
help.office_text: Every member of staff looks after one part of your Unraid server. The reception shows what each of them has to report; the tabs at the top lead to their desks.
help.office_text_plugin: Every member of staff looks after one part of your Unraid server. The reception shows what each of them has to report; the tabs at the top lead to their desks. In Unraid the office sits in the menu bar — or wherever you put it under ⋯ → Entry in Unraid (Settings, or a button in the header). Its state is also a tile on the Dashboard.
help.dot_text_plugin: Top right, next to ⋯. Green with «Messenger is in»: he checked in within the last 70 seconds (he does so every 20). Red: he isn't running, and the text beside it says why («Messenger is away», «Array stopped», «Data folder missing») — you see the last known state and nothing can be changed. Grey: still loading. A click on it opens this help.
help.languages_text_plugin: The office speaks the language set in Unraid if a translation exists, otherwise English; ⋯ → Language picks another one for this browser. Adding a language means adding JSON files:
help.agent_text: The web page runs in an ordinary container and can't touch zfs, docker or Unraid's configuration. That's done by the messenger, a small agent on the host: he picks up the desks' requests and brings back the answers. He runs as the second service of the stack, started by
help.dot_text: The dot top left. Green: the messenger checked in within the last 70 seconds (he does so every 20). Red: he isn't running — you see the last known state and nothing can be changed. Grey: still loading.
help.start_text: The page cannot start him: without the messenger it can't reach the server at all. Docker starts him together with the office and restarts him if he stops. If the dot stays red, start the stack again in the Compose Manager.
help.languages_text: The office speaks your device's language if a translation exists, otherwise English; ⋯ → Language picks another one for this browser. Adding a language means adding JSON files:
help.security_text: Keep the office in your LAN. Reading is open; changing things can be protected with a PIN (⋯ → PIN). The messenger can do what root can do on the host, but he only accepts the actions the desks define and checks every request.
errors.no_user_script: There is no User Scripts entry "{name}".
errors.bad_cron: "{cron}" isn't a valid schedule (five fields, e.g. 0 3 * * *).
office.not_hired: {name} doesn't work here (yet) — the caretaker knows who could come.
office.tip_text: {names} is on board. If the jobs are done well, the team would be glad of a tip!
office.tip_text_many: {names} are on board. If the jobs are done well, the team would be glad of a tip!
errors.not_hired: This person doesn't work here (yet). The caretaker can hire them.
errors.always_there: The caretaker comes with the house — he is neither hired nor fired.
office.fire_text: {name} leaves the reception and the tabs. Data and settings stay — hired again, they pick up where they left off. The caretaker can hire them again.
office.tip_text_team: Happy with how the team works? Everyone is glad of a tip or a small pay rise — Jack Emby most of all, he fetches the coffee after all.
auth.read_hint: Without the PIN the office then shows nothing at all — no shares, paths, containers, logs. Good when others in your network shouldn't read along.
auth.read_on: Looking needs the PIN now, too.
auth.read_off: Looking works without the PIN again.
auth.locked_text: Looking needs the PIN. This browser then stays unlocked for 12 hours.
auth.unlock_text_read: This office is protected — for looking too. Enter the PIN; this browser then stays unlocked for 12 hours.
agent.array_stopped_text: The office keeps its data in appdata — it gets back to work as soon as the array runs.
agent.no_data_title: The office's data folder is missing.
agent.no_data_text: {dir} doesn't exist. The messenger creates it once the array runs; if it stays missing, check DATA_DIR in /boot/config/plugins/unraid-secretary-office/unraid-secretary-office.cfg.
help.agent_text_plugin: The web page only shows things. What happens on the server — zfs, docker, Unraid's configuration — is done by the messenger, a small agent the plugin runs as a service: he picks up the desks' requests from a mailbox folder and brings back the answers. He starts with the array and stops before the array goes down.
help.start_text_plugin: The plugin starts the messenger itself: when it is installed, at boot and whenever the array starts. If the dot stays red while the array runs, look into his log (⋯ → Messenger's log) or reinstall the plugin under Plugins.
help.security_text_plugin: The office is part of Unraid's web UI: only who is logged in to Unraid gets in. Changing things can be protected with a PIN as well (⋯ → PIN). The messenger can do what root can do on the host, but he only accepts the actions the desks define and checks every request.
dash.locked: Locked — enter the PIN in the office to see more.
office.menu_text: What it is called there. In the menu bar Unraid shows a new name on this page right away, everywhere else after the next page load.
office.menu_place_menu: Its own entry in the menu bar, between Apps and Tools
office.menu_place_settings: An icon under Settings → User Utilities, as before
office.menu_place_button: Only a button in Unraid's header, next to search and the terminal
office.menu_own_hint: Up to {max} characters: letters, digits, spaces and . & + _ -
errors.logged_out: Your Unraid session has ended — please log in again.
errors.stale_page: Unraid rejected the request: the page is out of date (the server was restarted?). Reload it and try again.
